versions.changelog: Polish phase-gated workflow explanation, clarify when to use, add stronger validation rules, and update metadata.

Initial release introducing a structured 4-phase workflow for disciplined coding tasks.

- Enforces a pipeline: Plan (hypothesis) → Code (one fix) → Validate (root cause) → Debug (max 3 tries, escalate)
- Strictly prevents blind patching, retry loops, and symptom-only fixes.
- Details explicit rules, exit criteria, and loop-back triggers for each phase.
- Activates for bugs, features, refactoring, and any non-trivial coding change.
- Includes anti-patterns and quick-reference tables for phase transitions and detection triggers.
